name: Cold Outreach Personalizer
problem: Outbound stalls when every prospect gets the same email. A batch of prospects goes in, a tailored 3-touch sequence comes out for each one, so reply rates are not capped by how long personalization takes.

name: Investor Update Drafter
problem: Founders skip investor updates when the numbers are messy, and investors lose the thread. Raw metrics and bullets go in, a clean update comes out with a numeric sanity check built in.

name: Automation Priority Sorter
problem: Early teams automate whatever is loudest, not whatever frees the most time for growth work. Submit a manual pain point, it gets scored in real time and ranked in a shared backlog.
